notes.returns: Total returns are estimates: disclosures give value ranges, so each trade uses the midpoint; returns run from the closing price on the trade date to the latest close (Yahoo Finance, adjusted).
notes.positions: Positions are rebuilt from the last 400 days of disclosed trades only, so older holdings are missing.
notes.trump: Trump trades come from news reports of his OGE 278-T filings (seed/trump_trades.csv), not the full filings, which are scanned PDFs with thousands of lines. Treat them as partial.
notes.disclosure_lag: Members of Congress have up to 45 days to disclose a trade.
